UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Cloud-synced assistant preferences for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

displayName.description: User display name (defaults to Administrador Kirionce).

affectionateMode.description: Whether Modo cariñosa is enabled for Alice and Yui.

autoVoiceReply.description: Whether assistant replies are spoken automatically.

selectedModel.description: Active Gemini model ID used with Firebase AI Logic.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message in a user's Alice, Yui, or Group chat channel.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

errorFlag.description: True when this system message represents an error.

sequenceOrder.description: Monotonic client timestamp/order for deterministic multi-turn sorting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user synced assistant settings and preferences.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced chat messages across Alice, Yui, and Group channels.
